mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined in the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 245.0 (CPIAUCSL), it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 245.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate signals an overheating economy triggering aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased and UNRATE decreased, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer demand and corporate investment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior month signals strong labor market conditions supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increased, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market supporting consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion across housing and manufacturing sectors, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO increased, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain recovery phases, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals improved manufacturing output and reduced bottlenecks, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during supply chain recovery when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
